verses: Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa ney uss aurat ki baat suni jo tujh say apney shoher kay baray mein takraar ker rahi thi aur Allah kay aagay shikayat ker rahi thi, Allah Taalaa tum dono kay sawal o jawab sunn raha tha, be-shak Allah Taalaa sunnay dekhney wala hai

Tum mein say jo log apni biwiyon say zahaar kertay hain (yani unhen maa keh bethtay hain) woh dar-asal unn ki maayen nahi bann jatin, unn ki maayen to o hi hain jin kay batan say woh peda huye, yaqeenan yeh log aik maqool aur jhooti baat kehtay hain. Be-shak Allah Taalaa moaf kerney wala aur bakhshney wala hai

Jo log apni biwiyon say zahaar keren phir apni kahi hui baat say rujoo kerlen to unn kay zimmay aapas mein aik doosray ko hath laganey say pehlay aik ghulam aazad kerna hai, uss kay zariye tum naseehat kiye jatay ho. Aur Allah Taalaa tumharay tamam aemaal say ba-khabar hai

Haan jo shakhs na paye uss kay zimmay do maheenon kay lagataar rozay hain uss say pehlay kay aik doosray ko hath lagayen aur jiss shakhs ko yeh taqat bhi na ho uss per saathh miskeenon ka khana khilana hai. Yeh uss liye kay tum Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki hukum bardari kero, yeh Allah Taalaa ki muqarrar kerdah hadden hain aur kuffaar hi kay liye dard naak azab hai

Be-shak jo log Allah aur uss kay rasool ki mukhalifat kertay hain woh zaleel kiye jayen gay jaisay unn say pehlay kay log zaleel kiye gaye thay, aur be-shak hum wazeh aayaten utaar chukay hain aur kafiron kay liye to zillat wala azab hai

Jiss din Allah Taalaa unn sab ko uthaye ga phir unhen unn kay kiye huye amal say aagah keray ga, jissay Allah ney shumar rakha hai aur jissay yeh bhool gaye thay, aur Allah Taalaa her cheez say waqif hai

Kiya tu ney nahi dekha kay Allah aasmano ki aur zamin ki her cheez say waqif hai. Teen aadmiyon ki sirgoshi nahi hoti magar Allah unn ka chotha hota hai aur na paanch ki magar unn ka chata woh hota hai aur na uss say kum ki aur na ziyadah ki magar woh sath hi hota hai jahan bhi woh hun, phir qayamat kay din unhen unn kay aemaal say aagah keray ga be-shak Allah Taalaa her cheez say waqif hai

Kiya tu ney unn logon ko nahi dekha? Jinhen kaana phoosi say rok diya gaya tha woh phir bhi uss rokay huye kaam ko doobara kertay hain aur aapas mein gunah ki aur zulm o ziyadti ki aur na-farmani payghumbar ki sirgoshiyan kertay hain, aur jab teray pass aatay hain to tujhay unn lafzon mein salam kertay hain jin lafzon mein Allah Taalaa ney nahi kaha aur apney dil mein kehtay hain kay Allah Taalaa humen uss per jo hum kehtay hain saza kiyon nahi deta, unn kay liye jahannum kafi (saza) hai jiss mein yeh jayen gay, so woh bura thikana hai

Aey eman walo! tum jab sirgoshi kero to yeh sirgoshiyan gunah aur zulm (ziyadti) aur na-farmani payghumbar ki na hun, balkay)yeh neki aur perhezgari ki baaton per sirgoshi kero aur uss Allah say dartay raho jiss kay pass tum sab jama kiye jao gay

(buri) sirgoshiyan, pus shetani kaam hai jiss say eman daron ko ranj phonchay. Go Allah Taalaa ki ijazat kay baghair woh unhen koi nuksan nahi phoncha sakta. Aur eman walon ko chahaiye kay Allah hi per bharosa rakhen

Aey musalmano! jab tum say kaha jaye kay majlison mein zara kushadgi peda kero to tum jagah kushadah ker do Allah tumhen kushadgi dey ga, aur jab kaha jaye kay uth kharay ho jao to tum uth kharay ho jao Allah Taalaa tum mein say unn logon kay jo eman laye hain aur jo ilm diye gaye hain darjay buland ker dey ga, aur Allah Taalaa (her uss kaam say) jo tum ker rahey ho (khoob) khabardaar hai

Aey musalmano! jab tum rasool) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (say sirgoshi kerna chahao to apni sirgoshi say pehlay kuch sadqa dey diya kero yeh tumharay haq mein behtar aur pakeezah tar hai, haan agar na pao to be-shak Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai

Kiya tum apni sirgoshi say pehlay sadqa nikalney say darr gaye? Pus jab tum ney yeh na kiya aur Allah Taalaa ney bhi tumhen moaf farma diya to abb (bakhoobi) namazon ko qaeem rakho zakat detay raha kero aur Allah Taalaa ki aur uss kay rasool ki tabeydaari kertay raho. Tum jo kuch kertay ho uss (sab) say Allah (khoob) khabardaar hai

Kiya tu ney unn logon ko nahi dekha? Jinhon ney uss qom say dosti ki jin per Allah ghazab chuka hai, na yeh (munafiq) tumharay hi hain na unn kay hain bawajood ilm kay phir bhi jhoot per qasmen kha rahey hain
Allah Taalaa ney unn kay liye sakht azab tayyar ker rakha hai, tehqeeq jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain bura ker rahey hain
Unn logon ney to apni qasmon ko dhaal bana rakha hai aur logon ko Allah ki raah say roktay hain unn kay liye ruswa kerney wala azab hai
Unn kay maal aur unn ki aulad Allah kay haan kuch kaam na aayen gi. Yeh to jahannumi hain hamesha hi uss mein rahen gay

Jiss din Allah Taalaa unn sab ko utha khara keray ga to yeh jiss tarah tumharay samney qasmen khatay hain (Allah Taalaa) kay samney bhi qasmen khaney lagen gay aur samjhen gay kay woh bhi kissi (daleel) per hain, yaqeen mano kay be-shak o hi jhootay hain
Unn per shetan ney ghalba hasil kerliya hai, aur unhen Allah ka zikar bhala diya hai yeh shetani lashkar hai. Koi shak nahi kay shetani lashkar hi khasaray wala hai
Be-shak Allah Taalaa ki aur uss kay rasool ki jo log mukhalifat kertay hain o hi log sab say ziyadah zaleelon mein hain
Allah Taalaa likh chuka hai kay be-shak mein aur meray payghumbar ghalib rahen gay. Yaqeenan Allah Taalaa zor aawar aur ghalib hai

Allah Taalaa per aur qayamat kay din per eman rakhney walon ko aap Allah aur uss kay rasool ki mukhalifat kerney walon say mohabbat rakhtay huye hergiz na payen gay go woh unn kay baap ya unn kay betay ya unn kay bhai ya unn kay kunba (qabeelay) kay (aziz) hi kiyon na hun. Yehi log hain jin kay dilon mein Allah Taalaa ney eman ko likh diya hai aur jin ki taeed apni rooh say ki hai aur jinhen unn jannaton mein dakhil keray ga jin kay neechay nehren beh rahi hain jahan yeh hamesha rahen gay, Allah unn say razi hai aur yeh Allah say khush hain yeh khudaee lashkar hai, aagah raho be-shak Allah kay giroh walay hi kaamyaab log hain
